newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Honduras bars imports of Mexican strawberries.
newsitem.headline: Honduras bars imports of Mexican strawberries.

text.p: Honduras on Tuesday temporarily barred imports of Mexican strawberries because of fears they might contain the hepatitis virus, Agriculture Minister Ricardo Arias said.
The move came after some 170 Michigan schoolchildren and teachers came down with hepatitis A earlier this month upon eating tainted strawberries grown in Mexico.
"Measures have been taken to prohibit the continued imports of strawberries from Mexico," Arias told reporters.
The ban will continue until at least until tests determine whether imports of Mexican strawberries are tainted, he said.

"We expect to have the results in the next 48 hours in order to adopt any corresponding measures," Arias said. "If we have a positive result, then a decision will be made on whether products that could affect the health of consumers will be barred from entering the country."
